summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Planet Image International Ltd, a foreign private issuer, reporting the execution of a letter of guarantee in favor of Bank of Communications for subsidiary Jiangxi Yibo E-Tech's loan facilities. The guarantee covers up to RMB30 million from April 21, 2026 to June 20, 2027. It is a standard financing support arrangement, not a special situation. The board approved the guarantee, no special pricing, premium, or structural complexity. No watch or risk-arb angle applicable.
